# N046 — Default tolerance projection wrong on non-default tolerance shapes (free CARTESIAN_POINT off PLANE within declared tolerance but beyond hard-coded internal tolerance)

<!-- Auto-generated; edit `STEP_PROBLEM_CATALOG.md` instead. -->

- OCCT MANTIS#0023552

## Description

A point-projection-onto-surface routine uses a hard-coded tolerance instead of consulting the input shape's vertex/edge tolerance or the file's declared UNCERTAINTY_MEASURE_WITH_UNIT. When the input context declares tolerance 1e-3, the projection fails because the routine still uses 1e-7. Typical fixture: a free CARTESIAN_POINT at e.g. (0.5, 0.5, 5e-4) sits 5e-4 above a PLANE z=0 — within the declared 1e-3 mm context tolerance, but the kernel can't project it.

## Reproducer recipe

PLANE z=0 with file-scope tolerance 1e-3; project a free CARTESIAN_POINT at (0.5, 0.5, 5e-4) onto the surface. Routine reports "no projection found" because internal tolerance is 1e-7.

## Expected kernel behavior

projection routines consume the source shape's tolerance; default value is a fallback only when no shape context is available.
